test_type: CR-034 - POS API Field Name Mismatches Fix
summary: CR-034 testing complete. All 8 test cases verified: Sub-recipe CRUD (Q1-Q3, Q7) and Recipe CRUD (Q4-Q6, Q8) working correctly after POS API field name fixes. Found and fixed one additional bug in RecipeCatalogue.jsx where 'name' state wasn't being set when selecting a food in add mode, causing the Create Recipe button to remain disabled.

tests.details: Created sub-recipe 'TEST_CR034_SubRecipe' with name, unit (gm), and ingredient (Ajwain, 50). Toast showed 'Sub-recipe created'. Sub-recipe appeared in list.
Updated sub-recipe name to 'TEST_CR034_Updated' and qty to 150. Toast showed 'Sub-recipe updated'. Changes persisted in list.
Deleted test sub-recipe via confirmation dialog. Toast confirmed deletion. Sub-recipe removed from list (0 results for 'TEST_CR034' search).

Created recipe for 'coffe' food with ingredient (Ajwain, 100gm). Toast showed 'Recipe created'. Recipe count increased from 1 to 2. Required fix to RecipeCatalogue.jsx to set name state on food selection.
Selected existing 'coffe' recipe, viewed ingredients (coffee beans, Milk), cost breakdown displayed (₹2.10/piece). Edit form loaded correctly with all data.
Deleted 'coffe' recipe via confirmation dialog. Toast showed 'Recipe deleted'. Recipe count decreased from 2 to 1. No 'reason required' error - delete with reason body working.
Sub-Recipe Master page loaded with 5 existing sub-recipes displayed in list with name, ingredient count, and stock quantity.
Recipes tab loaded with 2 existing recipes: 'coffe' (2 ingredients, 0 sub-recipes) and 'whole wheat elachi cookies with jaggery' (0 ingredients, 1 sub-recipe).

critical_code_review_comments: SubRecipeMaster.jsx: handleSave() correctly uses sub_recipe_name, subunit, ingredient (singular) for create and ingredients (plural) for update
RecipeCatalogue.jsx: handleSave() correctly uses name=Number(foodId), preparation_time, serves_people, {id,qty,unit} ingredient format
api.js: deleteRecipe() correctly sends {data: {reason: '...'}} body for recipe deletion
FIXED: RecipeCatalogue.jsx line 264 - Added name state update when selecting food in add mode to enable Create Recipe button
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up: TEST_CR034_SubRecipe (sub-recipe), coffe recipe (recreated after deletion test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-034 POS API field name fixes verified. Sub-recipe uses sub_recipe_name, subunit, ingredient (singular for create), ingredients (plural for update). Recipe uses name=food_id (integer), preparation_time, serves_people. Recipe delete requires reason body. Fixed bug where Create Recipe button was disabled due to name state not being set on food selection.

fix_applied.description: Changed food select onValueChange from setFoodId to also set name state from selected food for new recipes
fix_applied.after: <Select value={foodId} onValueChange={(v) => { setFoodId(v); const selectedFood = foods.find(f => String(f.id) === v); if (selectedFood && !recipe) { setName(selectedFood.name || ''); } }}>
